limitations: Neither Huang2020 supporting PDF nor Douchi2024 supplementary material was acquired. Original main text/graphics are complete, not whole publication-plus-SI verified. Huang facet/humidity/extra microscopy and Douchi 30-day oriented/scraped-surface phase claims are excluded from verified mechanism evidence.

Huang Figure3E has a square in the No microbe panel while the legend defines squares as anhydrite and prose says absent. Marker placement does not establish a resolved control peak; no control phase is inferred.

Douchi Results 3 micrograms chlorophyll/chip conflicts with Methods 200 micrograms/mL times100 microliters =20 micrograms/chip. XRD source-angle presentation also differs between Methods and Figure1B; no peak-angle conversion inferred.

Original natural gypsum versus later synthetic rehydrated-plaster feed, geometry, sterilization, humidity/light, duration and loading differ. Independent negative result has unreported phase detection limit and cannot universally exclude transformation.
G-MTQ-3P2 is genus-resolved, not shown axenic; Murray2021 explicitly calls the isolate set non-purified. No exclusive microbial causality or direct uptake of structural water is established.
The correction and reply concern the same Huang2020 experiment. Gypsum and anhydrite owners share that lineage as substrate/product; no extra independent replication counted.
No calibrated phase fraction, complete water balance, mineral recovery efficiency, industrial operation or criticality designation accepted.
